id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

versionEdits.description: We don't track version history for tags (the changes could be huge).  So no need for the versionEdits field to be persisted.

name.description: Name must match the id (enforced in beforeCreate) and can't be changed.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

tenantTagId.description: Unique numeric id assigned during creation of a tag in a tenant.

description.description: Description of the purpose of the tag.

packages.description: Ordered list of all packages provisioned in the tag.

repositories.description: Map of all repository names to versions provisioned in the tag.

packageFingerprints.description: Fingerprints by provisioned packages. see {@link packages} for order of packages.

infos.description: Map containing various administrative info about the last time the tag was provisioned.

activeMetadata.description: If set then tag will monitor respective metadata repositories for changes and will continuously provision them.

testMetadata.description: If set then tag will contain test metadata. Only valid for tags in `test` mode.

cacheContent.description: If true, Tag metadata file content will be cached in memory, when tag is loaded.

isRemote.description: Tag is created on a remote node/container is value is true

hwProfile.description: hardware profile to be used for bringing up the compute resource (vm, container). Valid only for bound tag.

useVm.description: VM use as the compute instance if true, else container instance is used. Valid only for remote tag.

useTenantDatastore.description: Creates logically isolated PG and Cassandra datastores. Valid only for remote tag.

isBound.description: Tag is bound to a c3 server node if value is true
